title: Human synovium regional proteomics analysis
projectDescription: To analyze regional expression differences of proteins in human synovium
sampleProcessingProtocol: Samples were dissected from PEN membrane slide using LMD7, leica.  Standard in solution digestion using sequencing grade tryspsin/lysC.  Digested pepitdes resuspend in 0.1% FA and analyzed on a TimsTof flex machine, using a 15 minutes gradient and default DIA setting
dataProcessingProtocol: Raw data generated by MS machine were searched using DIANN software in library mode against human uniprot database. The library file were generated by pooled synovium sample followed by fractionation using HPRP fractionation kit and analyzed in the same LC condition as samples, using same MS machine in default DDA mode.
